dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a smooth, moderate concave curvature fitting an inward spline from the posterior base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a wide pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree linear incline relative to the visible horizontal longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 0.95:1 ratio of the maximum visible base width to the maximum vertical pixel height.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple circular specular bokeh artifacts are visible along the trailing edge and posterior base of the fin due to out-of-focus water droplets.
